s1.syndrome_frame: Acute left flank pain with cyclical fevers and cardiac mass
salient_findings: Large left ventricular mass on TTE and TEE
Malignant spindle cell tumor on pathology
key_facts: 22-year-old man with no significant medical history
1 day of acute left flank pain
Developed cyclical fevers while hospitalized
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase
Immunostains revealed malignant spindle cell tumor
Cytogenetics showed SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation
Immunohistochemistry positive for epithelial membrane antigen (EMA)
Renal infarction on computed tomography
Large left ventricular mass on trans-thoracic echocardiography
Pedunculated LV mass emanating from the basal septum on TEE
Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging confirmed the mass location
Endomyocardial biopsies revealed malignant spindle cell tumor

shortlist.label: Synovial sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant spindle cell tumor with SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation

shortlist.label: Cardiac sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant spindle cell tumor in the heart

shortlist.label: Intimal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant tumor in the cardiac mass

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Malignant spindle cell tumor with possible cardiac origin

raw.rationale: The presence of SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation, which is a characteristic genetic abnormality of synovial sarcoma, along with the immunohistochemistry positive for epithelial membrane antigen (EMA) and the histology consistent with the monophasic variant of a malignant spindle cell tumor, strongly supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cardiac sarcoma
rejected.why: While the patient has a left ventricular mass, the specific genetic and immunohistochemical findings point more specifically to synovial sarcoma.

rejected.label: Intimal sarcoma
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence of intimal involvement or origin of the tumor from the intimal layer of blood vessels.

rejected.label: Cardiac angiosarcoma
rejected.why: The histology and genetic findings do not support angiosarcoma, which typically would show evidence of vascular differentiation.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: The lack of smooth muscle differentiation markers and the presence of SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation make leiomyosarcoma less likely.
